positive_terms: Description of approach to ensuring that processes to provide or enable remedy in event of material negative impacts on  consumers and end-users are available and effective in their implementation and outcomes
确保消费者补救流程可用有效的机制
描述主体如何确保在消费者和终端用户发生重大负面影响时，补救流程可得、可实施且结果有效。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
